name: RDB Alpha
onCreateCommand: sudo mkdir -p /workspaces/.persist/project /workspaces/.persist/vscode-user && sudo chown -R camper:camper /workspaces/.persist && sudo rm -rf /workspace/project; sudo ln -sfn /workspaces/.persist/project /workspace/project; mkdir -p ~/.vscode-remote/data && ln -sfn /workspaces/.persist/vscode-user ~/.vscode-remote/data/User
postStartCommand: [ -L /workspace/project ] || sudo rm -rf /workspace/project; sudo ln -sfn /workspaces/.persist/project /workspace/project; mkdir -p ~/.vscode-remote/data && ln -sfn /workspaces/.persist/vscode-user ~/.vscode-remote/data/User
